description:
## Portfolio Home
A welcoming portfolio landing page with shared app navigation, an editorial hero, three featured sample concepts, an About teaser, and a contact invitation. Preserves the existing home state and /home route.

### Navigation and content
Every internal action uses schema-confirmed LinkState objects targeting the existing bare home, projects, about, or contact page names. Featured shared cards receive linkDestination projects and the honest action label View projects; these concepts are not client case studies. Shared navigation and card components already resolve internal destinations to states and are reused unchanged. No fabricated identity, achievements, testimonials, imagery, or external URLs. Contact remains a local prototype on its existing page.

### Presentation
Bellini box layouts and intrinsic auto-fit grids provide responsive flow without fixed column placements. Supported element visual styles provide warm ivory, ink editorial typography, teal accents, constrained content width, responsive padding, and rounded panels. Core links and navigation retain their built-in keyboard and focus behavior. No utility classes, custom stylesheet, or new page.
